_comment: One POST /ask response body, recorded by hand from the shape pipeline.serve
declares, so tests/test_eval.py can score the --remote path with no network and
no credentials. It answers the golden question `matchup_win_rate` against the
fixture marts, so the same assertions hold on it as on a local run of that
question. Nothing here came off a deployed service: there is no run id, no URL
and no account in it, and the numbers are the fixture warehouse's.
If POST /ask grows a field, add it here; a mapping that silently drops one is
what this file exists to catch.
answer: Dragapult control has won the only game it has played against Alakazam / Toucannon: 1 win and 0 losses over 1 game, so the rate is 100% of a sample of one. The mart flags the row as thin (min_games_met is false), which is the honest reading of it.

tool_calls.input_summary: select archetype_name, opponent_archetype_name, games, wins, losses, win_rate, min_ga...

queries.sql: select archetype_name, opponent_archetype_name, games, wins, losses, win_rate, min_games_met from mart_matchups where archetype_name ilike 'Dragapult control' and opponent_archetype_name ilike 'Alakazam / Toucannon'
